title: WorkManager, for work that has to survive the app closing

videos.script: The student adds a session on the underground, with no signal, and puts the phone away. The planner still has to send it. Later, when there is a network, with nobody watching. {{process}} A coroutine cannot do that. It lives in the process, and the system ends the process when it likes. {{database}} WorkManager writes the request into its own small database, and hands the timing to the system. The process can die. The request is still on disk. {{worker}} Then a worker. One function, three possible answers: success, failure, or try again later. You will test all three on your computer. {{constraints}} Then the conditions. A network, a battery that is not nearly empty, and a period of six hours. A test driver says the network is back, without waiting. {{chain}} Then a chain, where one worker's output is the next one's input, and a retry holds up everything behind it. {{system}} And finally, what a real phone decides for you. Doze, standby buckets, and the one kind of stop that WorkManager does not survive.
